named-query.name: Action.findAllByUser
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM Action a WHERE a.user = :user

named-query.name: Bookmark.findByUrl
named-query.query: SELECT b FROM Bookmark b WHERE b.url = :url

named-query.name: Bookmark.findAllByUser
named-query.query: SELECT b FROM Bookmark b WHERE b.user = :user

named-query.name: Candidate.findCurriculumByCandidateId
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Curriculum c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.candidate LEFT JOIN FETCH c.education LEFT JOIN FETCH c.jobExperiences LEFT JOIN FETCH c.languages LEFT JOIN FETCH c.skills WHERE c.candidate.id = :id

named-query.name: Candidate.findById
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Candidate c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.files WHERE c.id = :id

named-query.name: Candidate.findByNameAndSurename
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Candidate c WHERE (:name IS NOT NULL AND c.name = :name) OR (:surename IS NOT NULL AND c.surename = :surename)

named-query.name: Client.findByName
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Client c WHERE c.name = :name

named-query.name: JobOffer.findByName
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.name = :name

named-query.name: JobOffer.findByOwner
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.owner = :owner

named-query.name: JobOffer.findLastJobOffers
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.owner = :owner ORDER BY j.id

named-query.name: JobMeeting.findPlannedJobMeetings
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobMeeting j WHERE j.jobCandidature.id = :jobCandidatureId

named-query.name: JobMeeting.findConductedJobMeetings
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobMeeting j WHERE j.jobCandidature.id = :jobCandidatureId

named-query.name: Role.findSubordinateRoles
named-query.query: SELECT r FROM RoleClosure rc JOIN rc.descendant r WHERE rc.antecessor.id = :id

named-query.name: User.findById
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u LEFT JOIN FETCH u.role WHERE u.id = :id

named-query.name: User.findByUsername
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u LEFT JOIN FETCH u.role WHERE u.username = :username

named-query.name: User.findSubordinateUsers
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM UserClosure uc JOIN uc.descendant u WHERE uc.antecessor.id = :id AND uc.pathLength > 0

named-query.name: User.findAll
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u LEFT JOIN FETCH u.role

named-query.name: User.findByNameAndSurename
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u LEFT JOIN FETCH u.role WHERE (:name IS NOT NULL AND u.name = :name) OR (:surename IS NOT NULL AND u.surename = :surename)

named-query.name: User.findUser
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u WHERE (:name IS NOT NULL AND u.name = :name) OR (:surename IS NOT NULL AND u.surename = :surename)

named-query.name: User.countAdminRoles
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(u) FROM User u WHERE u.role.name = 'ADMIN'

named-query.name: User.countEmail
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(u) FROM User u WHERE u.email = :email

named-query.name: UserClosure.findAntecessorsUserClosuresById
named-query.query: SELECT uc FROM UserClosure uc WHERE uc.descendant.id = :id
